name: finance_api_static_validation_expanded_business_cases_20260825
scope: 60 additional ordinary finance business cases covering major API families: 40 contract-valid calls and 20 plausible structural mistakes. Labels assess API/dataview structure only, never user-intent equivalence.

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代的股票代码、所属行业和上市日期。
cases.request: r1 = stock.basic_info(filter = "name = 宁德时代", limit = 1) -> code, name, industry, listed_date

cases.user_query: 列出2020年以后上市的股票，按上市日期倒序取20只。
cases.request: r1 = stock.basic_info(filter = "listed_date >= 2020-01-01", order = "listed_date desc", limit = 20) -> code, name, industry, listed_date

cases.user_query: 比较贵州茅台和五粮液今天的最新价、涨跌幅和成交额。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code in (600519.SH, 000858.SZ)", order = "code asc", limit = 2, mode = 2) -> code, name, tradedate, snapshot_time, close, pct, amount

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台最近30根5分钟K线。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 600519.SH", mode = 1, period = 5, count = 30) -> code, name, bar_start_time, bar_end_time, open, high, low, close, amount, volumn, is_finalized

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代最近20个交易日的日K。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 300750.SZ", order = "tradedate desc", mode = 0, count = 20) -> code, name, tradedate, open, high, low, close, pct, amount

cases.user_query: 计算贵州茅台近20日平均成交额。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote.kd_amount_avg(k = 20, filter = "code = 600519.SH", mode = 0) -> code, name, value as avg_amount_20d

cases.user_query: 找出近10日最高收盘价最高的10只股票。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote.kd_close_max(k = 10, order = "value desc", limit = 10, mode = 0) -> code, name, value as max_close_10d

cases.user_query: 统计最新行情中上涨股票的平均涨幅。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote.agg(filter = "pct > 0", agg = avg(stock.quote.pct), realtime = 1) -> avg_pct

cases.user_query: 比较贵州茅台与五粮液近期行情并给出区间波动分析。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(filter = "code in (600519.SH, 000858.SZ)", fields = "code, name, tradedate, close, pct", task = "比较两只股票近期行情的涨跌与波动", limit = 20, mode = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct

cases.user_query: 查询比亚迪最近交易日主力净流入和主力净占比。

cases.user_query: 查询近10日主力净流入合计最高的20只股票。

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台最新PE、PB和总市值。
